constraint_prompts.purpose: the poem's own lines are verified and timed to this reel
constraint_prompts.prompt: Find me at the harbor, at the small tables, watching. The couples orbit each other the way Jupiter keeps its moons — close, and counted. The elders clutch their pearls and pray. Life has burned all my love stories — victory-less seasons. So I harvest the flowers instead — scarlet poppies, purple blossoms — and they become my power. Then, a distant window. She says: you Don
